title: SMB hijacks programmed bolus progress popup and prevents cancellation of the programmed bolus
symptom: When programming a bolus while an SMB is being or about to be given, the progress popup shows the SMB progress instead of the programmed bolus progress, and the programmed bolus cannot be cancelled. This can lead to a slight overdose because the bolus wizard calculated based on IOB prior to the SMB.
cause: The progress popup is hijacked by an ongoing SMB when a manual bolus is sent during an SMB.
